title: tc-coordinate-details
description: Coordinates in text, checked and marked: hover, focus or right-click one for the place, both notations, mapping links and a map.

text.description: The text to find coordinates in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

trigger.description: What opens a card: "both" (hover, focus and right-click), "hover" (hover and focus) or "contextmenu" (right-click, Menu key, Enter)

hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer rests on a mark before its card opens, ms

precision.description: Decimal places shown in decimal notation

zoom.description: The zoom for mapping links and the map, 1–19

providers.description: Mapping tools for "Open in": URL templates with {lat} {lng} {zoom} {label}; empty hides the links

notFoundText.description: What the card says when there are no details for a place

errorText.description: What the card says when the lookup failed

GeoProvider.description: A mapping tool. `url` is a template: {lat}, {lng}, {zoom} and {label} are replaced, encoded for a URL. Only http(s) links are kept.
